description:
- Part single storey, part double storey extension to rear of house / property.
- Loft extension.
- Reconfiguration of internal layout of existing house / property.
- Rear garage conversion into live-work space as part of the same house / property with separate access from street.
- No change of use
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - By reason of their design, siting, scale and materials the proposed mansard roof extension, first floor rear extension and outbuilding would form prominent, unsympathetic and visually intrusive additions to the original building, streetscene and locality. The proposals would fail to be subservient and result in harm to the character and appearance of the Shaftesbury Park Estate Conservation Area. There are no public benefits that would outweigh the identified harm. The development is therefore contrary to the NPPF (2024), policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing (2016).

Reason : 2 - By reason of design, scale and location, the single, part two storey rear extension  would be an unneighbourly form of development that would result in loss of outlook and an increased sense of overbearing to the harm of neighbouring residential occupiers. Furthermore, the application has failed to demonstrate that there would not be harmful loss of daylight or sunlight to the ground floor rear window of No.22 Brassey Square.  The development is therefore contrary to policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and Wandsworth Housing SPD (2016).

Reason : 3 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to make available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
